plainTranslation: Composite Mercury in the 3 House: With Composite Mercury in the 3rd house, this is a house naturally ruled by Mercury, so communication can be very easy between the two of you, and you can more comfortable express yourselves and feel you’re being understood. This can be a beneficial placement for any type of relationship. You can feel you’re understood by one another better than with other people, and it can be easier and more natural for you to talk things over and open up.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
